title: fix(components): badge page:tabs tabs whose related list binds its parent by parentDataSource
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DWZEpY9vJu5mawox5gNXXf)_

Fixes #34250

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：应用页上的 `page:tabs`，标签里的关联列表如果用 `parentDataSource` 绑定父记录，标签在打开前就显示数量徽标；列表自己把它显示的条数报给所在标签，该标签预先挂载（隐藏）。
- 为什么改：云端 Team 页的「邀请」标签发出邀请后没有数字，只有点开才看到；原因是徽标只按页面的记录去计数，应用页没有记录。
- 风险与回滚：每个这样的标签在页面加载时多读一次父记录和一页子记录（默认 5 行）；记录页上没有绑定的关联列表计数方式不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`（哪些标签预挂载、哪些列表不再探测）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`（上报时机）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx`（只在绑定父记录时上报）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.parentDataSource-12294.test.tsx`，预期 16 个用例全过，其中 5 个是本卡新增。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `page:tabs` (`containers.tsx`): a `record:related_list` whose `parentDataSource` is a binding (`isElementDataSourceConfig`, the predicate `ParentRecordBinding` reads it by) is no longer probed by the strip, and a tab that holds such a list (among the lists its gates let the badge count) is kept mounted while inactive, the way a `list-view` tab already is (objectstack#26613).
- `record:related_list` (`record-related-list.tsx`): when its parent is bound by `parentDataSource`, it hands its panel's count reporter (`usePageTabCountReporter`) to the list through a package-internal context, `RelatedListTotalReportContext` (`relatedListCompact.ts`, not exported from the package entry, so no public prop is added).
- `RelatedList`: reports the number its header shows (`recordCount`) once its read has settled; a list still reading, whose read failed or whose filter was refused says nothing.

Route: the card offered (a) resolving the probe's parent from `parentDataSource`, or (b) the list reporting its count. (a) cannot reuse the list's own parent read: that read is `BoundRecordProvider`, module-private in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, and `@object-ui/components` cannot import from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (the dependency runs the other way), so (a) would mean a second hand-written parent read beside it. (b) reuses the list's own parent binding, scope and filter, and the #26613 force-mount gives the number before the tab is opened.

Invalidation: there is no new `RelatedCountStore` key. A create or delete on the child object reaches the list through the data-change bus (`notifyDataChanged` dispatches the `objectui:related-changed` event `RelatedList` re-reads on), and the re-read reports the new number. Pinned below.

Unchanged: lists whose parent is the page's record are probed with the same store keys and the same invalidation; an authored `count` on a tab item still wins and leaves the tab mounted on open only.

## Why

The hosted console Team page (objectstack-ai/cloud#4304, item 4) is an app page whose tabs are related lists bound to the current organization by `parentDataSource`. The strip keyed its probe on `ctx?.recordId`, which an app page does not have, so no badge was drawn. On a record page the same list was probed against the page's record, which is not its parent, so the badge counted the wrong parent's rows.

## Tests

Five pins, a new top-level `describe` in the existing harness `record-related-list.parentDataSource-12294.test.tsx` (the REAL `page:tabs` around the REAL block):

1. App page: the Members tab is badged `2` (the bound parent's rows) while the first tab is still active; every child read is scoped to the bound parent.
2. A create, then a delete, on the child object (announced through `notifyDataChanged`) moves the badge 2 → 3 → 2.
3. An authored `count: 7` wins, and the inactive tab reads nothing (no parent read, no child read).
4. CONTROL, record page, unbound list: exactly one child read, the strip's `$top: 1` probe keyed on the page's record; the list is not mounted.
5. Record page, bound list: the badge is the bound parent's count; no child read uses the page's record.

No existing test was edited.

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; mutation landed and restored with blob == HEAD)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `containers.tsx`: the force-mount arm for a parent-bound list replaced by `false` | 3 failed / 13 passed (pins 1, 2, 5) |
| 2 | `containers.tsx`: the probe exclusion disabled | 1 failed / 15 passed (pin 5: badge counts the page record too) |
| 3 | `RelatedList.tsx`: the report call removed | 3 failed / 13 passed (pins 1, 2, 5) |
| 4 | `record-related-list.tsx`: the reporter never handed down | 3 failed / 13 passed (pins 1, 2, 5) |

Vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source here, so each leg ran against the mutated source with no build step.
</details>

<details><summary>Page-load cost (asked for by the seat): an app page with two parent-bound tabs, neither opened</summary>

A throwaway harness (not committed): `page:tabs` with Overview (active), Members (30 members) and Invitations (3 invitations), each list bound to one `sys_organization` row by `parentDataSource`, spec default `limit` 5.

- Base `7be32d39`: 0 `find` calls, no badges.
- This head: 4 `find` calls — `sys_organization` `$top: 1` twice (each list's parent read), `sys_member` `$top: 5` (5 rows), `sys_invitation` `$top: 5` (3 rows); badges `Members 30`, `Invitations 3`. Plus 6 `getObjectSchema` calls (parent and child object per list, the reads the lists make when shown).
- Route (a) would also send 2 reads per tab (a parent read and a one-row count probe); the difference is the up-to-`limit` rows each hidden list loads.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `usePageTabCountReporter` returns a fresh function each render, so the list's report effect re-runs on each render; `report` returns the previous state for an equal count, so it causes no extra render. Same as the `list-view` reporter today.
- A list whose re-read fails after a success keeps its last reported number on the badge (the reporter has no withdraw short of unmount), as a `list-view` tab does.
- `ui` lint on the five touched files: 0 errors (warnings are pre-existing `any` and fast-refresh notices; one new `any` in `isParentBoundList(rl: any)`, matching the walk helpers beside it).

## Verification

Head `eb87f29c`.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` — exit 0 (both packages, `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` (whole package) — Test Files 379 passed, 1 skipped (380); Tests 3388 passed, 18 skipped.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run` over the 26 components test files naming `page:tabs`, `RelatedCountStore` or `usePageTabCountReporter` — Test Files 26 passed; Tests 221 passed. The rest of `@object-ui/components` and the app-shell consumers are left to CI's Test UI shards (narrowed, declared).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` — 38 derived families, each run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
</details>
